decisions.reason: Despite its fading website visibility after launch, this printer is close to the core hardware business and carries enough development investment and strategic fit for management to continue backing it.
The module was publicly launched as part of the digital inline printing portfolio and directly supports the firm's declared move toward digitalization and traceability, so commitment remains strong.
As a named successor app tied to code decoding and traceability, it is somewhat less central than core equipment but still fits the announced digital direction well enough to retain.
An inline code verification system is highly consistent with the firm's traceability strategy and integrated solution model, which makes management unlikely to withdraw it soon.
The print layout design software reinforces common operation across systems and the broader software stack, so sunk development effort and strategic coherence favor keeping it.
